lines.text: MINISTERE DE LA SANTE PUBLIQUE DE LA POPULATION
DIRECTION DE LA REGION SANITAIRE N° 7
TOUS LES JOURS DE LUNDI A VENDREDI

notes: White board on posts in front of a health office, 5e arrondissement, Bangui; header in black, vaccination notice in blue; the 'A' in '0 A 11' is small. Small motto 'Unité - Dignité - Travail' under the flag and the GAVI/OMS/unicef logos are left out. A sun flare crosses the top-left. Red Cross ambulances at left are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
